<answer>
You can tell who liked your tweet by using websites such as Favotter.net and Favstar.fm, or by going to Twitter.com and logging in with your Twitter username and password. Once logged in, click on your Twitter name, located on the upper right hand corner of your account's Home page, then click on Settings and finally Blue Notifications link at the top of the screen. By setting this feature, you will receive an email notification whenever someone marks one of your tweets as one of their favorites.
</answer>
